figurative_meaning_bn: দিনের বেলায়, দিনের আলো থাকতে থাকতে
figurative_meaning_en: During the daytime, while there is daylight
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে দিনে দিনে বাড়ি ফিরে আসবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He will return home during the day.
It is safer to work in the daytime.
note: This expression emphasizes visibility and safety associated with daylight in traditional Bengali contexts.
